labReference.meaning: Within this documented adult assay reference; laboratories may use different limits. This is not proof of optimal health.
labReference.location: Section 13, PDF page 18 (zero-based page 17), lines 643–645 in web extraction; clinical relevance section PDF page 3.

prevention.meaning: An ESC/EAS 2025 cardiovascular risk modifier considered with overall health history and risk factors, not a universal optimum, diagnosis or treatment target.
prevention.location: Box 1, risk modifiers beyond SCORE2/SCORE2-OP; in the co-published Atherosclerosis PDF this is PDF page 6. Official ESC slide set also reproduces the risk-modifier box.

prospectiveEvidence.study: Emerging Risk Factors Collaboration, Lancet 2010; 160,309 people without prior vascular disease in 54 prospective studies.
prospectiveEvidence.meaning: Association with later cardiovascular events; not an individual prediction or evidence that CRP itself is causal.

overlap.meaning: Inside this illustrative lab reference and above the conditional persistent-risk modifier. No universal unhealthy or safe zone is implied.

worked_example.context: Repeat when clinically stable; illness, infection, injury and other inflammatory causes can affect hs-CRP. Timing depends on clinical context; no universal interval or automatic treatment is specified.
worked_example.review: CMO agent source/copy evidence review; not human clinician approval.

medical_contract.basis: Frozen CMO medical-spec.json; values and inequalities are case facts, not a CSS snapshot.
medical_contract.meaning: Reference-in-range can overlap a conditional risk modifier; not a universal optimal/safe band, diagnosis, probability or disease prediction.

implementation: One independent 3.2 mg/L example, two labelled reference questions and one coherent 0–6 mg/L graphic.

The lab band ends at 5 and the risk-review band begins above 2; a restrained overlap window between 2 and 5 demonstrates how the statements coexist. Both measurement points share 53.333% of the scale; risk and laboratory boundaries sit at 33.333% and 83.333%.
One takeaway explains future-risk relevance if persistent. Its strong lead and regular remainder are one unchanged sentence, not two claims.
Repeat when well, laboratory variation and no diagnosis remain visible. Fuller history/risk-factor/confounder context and three evidence links are in native details.
No universal optimal/safe region, personal risk percentage, probability curve, inevitable disease, CRP causation, automatic treatment or fixed universal repeat interval.
Existing EVA glass, dotted number, Hanken 400/600 and Georgia style are preserved, with complete static/reduced-motion meaning and the existing 500ms entry.
